subject: Pen-test report validity, retest options, and evidence delivery
messages:
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@bigbank.com>

Cc: acme-security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-07-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pen-test deliverables & report age acceptance for SIG

Hi Kimberly / Karthik,

We're working through the SIG questionnaire and need to confirm a few items related to your recent pentest. Our security policy requires either a full pen-test report or an attestation plus evidence. Specifically:

- Acceptance window: we typically accept reports no older than 6 months.
- Firm credentials: please confirm the assessor firm name, relevant certifications (e.g., CREST, OSCP, CREST-approved?), and whether remedial verification was performed by the same firm.
- Methodology: quick summary (OWASP, NIST SP800-115, manual code review scope?) and whether internal/external scoping was used.
- Remediation verification: do you offer re-test (verification) after fixes? If so, is that a targeted verification or a full re-test, and what is the target SLA after remediation?

We can accept a redacted report + attestation letter if that is necessary for disclosure. If you have a sample attestation and a short summary PDF we can upload to our SIG response, that would speed things up.

Also attaching the relevant SIG extract for context (acme_SIG_request.pdf).

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Doe
Information Security Manager | BigBank Inc.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@bigbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: pen-test deliverables & report age acceptance for SIG

Hi Jane — thanks for the clear ask and the SIG extract. Short answers up front, details below:

- Report age: our most recent assessment was performed 2026-04-01; we can provide a redacted report plus an attestation letter.
- Firm: BlueRidge Security LLC (CREST-aligned testers; lead tester OSCP / CREST equivalent).
- Methodology: external black-box network + authenticated web app testing. Approach aligned to OWASP Top 10 + NIST SP 800-115 for verification, with manual validation and PoC screenshots where applicable.
- Remediation verification: we offer a complimentary targeted verification for fixes within 45 days (verification limited to the remediated items / PoC retests). Full re-test option is available (scope: same as original engagement) — typically quoted separately.

Attachments I can provide right away: redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf (1p summary suitable for SIG), redwood-pen-test-attestation.pdf (signed attestation + assessment metadata). If BigBank requires full report delivery, we will need an NDA in place and we generally provide a redacted report for third-party visibility.

Questions for you: do you require a full re-test (re-running the entire engagement) or will targeted verification of remediated findings be sufficient for SIG? Also confirm whether your 6-month requirement is hard cutoff — if so we can include a dated attestation that references the 2026-04-01 test date.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if that helps.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference

Kimberly — thanks. A couple of clarifying questions before we proceed:

1) Our SIG process flags items >6 months as requiring a reassessment. Will the 2026-04-01 date be acceptable or do we need a re-test to be within 6 months of our submission date (we plan to submit the SIG on 2026-08-02)?

2) For remediation verification: is the complimentary verification limited only to confirming that specific CVEs / PoCs are fixed (targeted), or will BlueRidge also look for regressions / adjacent issues discovered during retest?

3) PoC artifacts: do you include PoC screenshots/requests in the redacted report or only in the full report? We typically need at least screenshots + remediation notes to mark items as mitigated.

If redacted + attestation works, we can proceed quickly. Otherwise we can arrange an NDA and request the full report.

Regards,
Jane
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@bigbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-07-19T14:40:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: pen-test deliverables & report age acceptance for SIG

Hi Jane — answers inline and a couple of procedural notes.

1) Report age: your planned submission on 2026-08-02 is 4 months after our assessment (2026-04-01), so the report falls within your 6-month acceptance window. We will provide a dated attestation that explicitly lists the assessment date and scope; that should be acceptable for SIG unless your auditor requires a fresh engagement.

2) Remediation verification: complimentary verification is targeted — BlueRidge will validate the specific PoCs/ findings that were marked fixed. They do limited regression checks around the fixed area but this is not a full re-test. If you need exhaustive regression testing, we recommend the full re-test option (same scope as original), which we can schedule and quote (typical list price $15,000 for full external engagement; targeted verification complimentary when fixes are submitted within 45 days).

3) PoC artifacts: redacted report includes summary PoC text and sanitized screenshots that demonstrate exploitability without exposing sensitive payloads. Full reports include raw PoCs and detailed reproduction steps — those are only shared under an NDA. We will include remediation notes and the verification outcome in the attestation.

Attachments: redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf (one-page summary for SIG), redwood-pen-test-attestation.pdf (signed).

Process items:
- If you accept the redacted summary + attestation, I can upload the files to a shared Drive folder and send a DocuSign link for the DPA/NDA if you want the full report later.
- If you need a full re-test, tell us your preferred window; we generally book re-tests 2–4 weeks post-request depending on BlueRidge availability.

Quoted for transparency: BlueRidge lead tester: Priya S. — CREST-equivalent, OSCP, 6+ years application security. Assessment method: external authenticated + manual verification, OWASP Top 10 + custom business-logic checks.

Let me know what you'd like us to upload and we can get the Drive link and DocuSign over by EOD.

Best,
Kimberly
